Buttery shortbread fingers baked pale and crisp, sandwiched with raspberry jam and dusted with icing sugar. Beat 200g soft butter with 100g icing sugar until pale. Mix in 250g plain flour and 50g cornflour to a soft dough. Press into a lined 20 x 30cm tin, prick all over and bake at 160C for 25 to 30 minutes until pale golden. Cut into 24 fingers while warm and cool in the tin. Sandwich pairs with 120g raspberry jam and dust with icing sugar.
the flight that gets diverted to Boston, with their luggage left behind

Little cocktail franks glazed in honey, mustard and brown sugar until sticky, speared on toothpicks with pickled onions. Simmer 500g cocktail franks in water for 3 minutes and drain. In a frying pan melt 20g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Add the franks and toss over medium heat for 5 minutes until sticky and glazed. Serve on toothpicks with cocktail onions.

s.note: Buttery shortbread fingers baked pale and crisp, sandwiched with raspberry jam and dusted with icing sugar.
s.how: Beat 200g soft butter with 100g icing sugar until pale. Mix in 250g plain flour and 50g cornflour to a soft dough. Press into a lined 20 x 30cm tin, prick all over and bake at 160C for 25 to 30 minutes until pale golden. Cut into 24 fingers while warm and cool in the tin. Sandwich pairs with 120g raspberry jam and dust with icing sugar.

s.note: Little cocktail franks glazed in honey, mustard and brown sugar until sticky, speared on toothpicks with pickled onions.
s.how: Simmer 500g cocktail franks in water for 3 minutes and drain. In a frying pan melt 20g butter with 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Add the franks and toss over medium heat for 5 minutes until sticky and glazed. Serve on toothpicks with cocktail onions.

m.note: Seared rib eye, fried eggs, crisp hash browns and buttered toast.
m.how: Grate 600g potatoes and squeeze dry in a tea towel. Season with 1/2 tsp salt, shape into 4 hash browns and fry in 40g butter over medium heat for 6 minutes a side. Sear 4 rib eye steaks, 200g each, in a very hot pan with 1 tbsp oil for about 3 minutes a side to 54C, then rest for 8 minutes. Fry 8 eggs in 20g butter for 3 minutes. Toast 4 sourdough slices and spread with 20g butter. Serve one steak, two eggs, one hash brown and one toast per person.

w.note: Baked New York cheesecake chilled overnight and topped with strawberries.
w.how: Crush 120g digestive biscuits and mix with 50g melted butter. Press into a lined 18cm springform tin. Beat 400g cream cheese with 100g caster sugar, then mix in 100g sour cream, 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla. Pour over the base. Wrap the tin in two layers of foil and stand in a roasting dish with hot water halfway up its sides. Bake at 150C for 70 minutes until the centre gently wobbles. Cool for 1 hour, refrigerate overnight and top with 200g sliced strawberries. Cut four generous portions, with leftovers.

d.note: Gin and dry vermouth stirred cold with an olive garnish.
d.how: For each of 4 drinks stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over ice for 30 seconds. Strain into a frozen martini glass and garnish with 1 green olive.
